meta.name: competitive-teardown
meta.description: 定位图 + 功能矩阵 + 价格对比 + 机会窗口, 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做产品竞品分析或制定产品策略
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor data into product decision reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing competitors or defining product strategy

howto.what: 使用后，Claude 会把用户提供的竞品官网、定价、评论等资料整理成一份产品决策报告，包含定位图、功能矩阵、价格解读、机会窗口和行动建议，并标出资料缺口。
howto.when: 当用户提供竞品资料（官网、定价、评论等）并要求做竞品拆解、对比功能或寻找机会窗口时触发；单个竞品也可以。

say.text: 帮我把这三家竞品的官网和定价页拆成一份对比报告
say.note: 会生成战情室风格的拆解报告

say.text: 比较我提供的几个竞品，列出功能矩阵和机会窗口
say.note: 输出定位图与行动建议

say.text: 根据这些资料做单竞品 deep dive，标出优势和弱点
say.note: 单竞品也生成完整报告

howto.what_en: After installation, when you supply competitor websites, pricing, and reviews, Claude organizes them into a product decision report with a positioning map, feature matrix, pricing read, and opportunity windows, flagging missing evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide competitor materials (websites, pricing, reviews, etc.) and ask for a teardown, feature comparison, or opportunity analysis; single competitor also works.

say_en.text: Turn these three competitors' websites and pricing pages into a comparison report.
Compare these competitors and list a feature matrix plus opportunity windows.
Do a single-competitor deep dive, noting strengths and weaknesses.
